name: blinko-mini
description: A single-user Telegram Mini App for capturing blinks and growing notes.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm --workspace server run dev" "npm --workspace web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace web run build && npm --workspace server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace server run typecheck && npm --workspace web run typecheck
